prop.name: value
prop.help: Set the value as a raw integer. The displayed format depends on `digit_count` and `dec_point_pos`

prop.name: rollover
prop.help: If enabled, stepping past the maximum jumps to the minimum and vice versa

prop.name: digit_count
prop.help: Set the number of digits, excluding the sign and the decimal separator

prop.name: dec_point_pos
prop.help: Set the number of digits before the decimal point. 0 means no decimal point is shown

prop.name: step
prop.help: Set the digit that changes on increment/decrement. Can be 1, 10, 100, etc.

prop.name: bind_value
prop.help: Connect a subject to the spinbox's value

part.name: main
part.help: The background and the number text (extends lv_textarea): background, padding and text properties.

part.name: scrollbar
part.help: The scrollbar shown when content overflows: `width` (thickness), background properties and padding.

part.name: selected
part.help: The selected text. Only `text_color` and `bg_color` are used.

part.name: cursor
part.help: The cursor over the edited digit: `bg_color`/`bg_opa` for a block cursor or a left border for a bar cursor.
